name: Danny Rampling
editorial_article: Born in 1961 in Streatham, London, Danny Rampling is a central figure in the development of the British house music scene. He gained foundational inspiration during a 1987 trip to Ibiza, where he visited the Amnesia nightclub and witnessed DJ Alfredo playing eclectic house tracks. Following this experience, he co-founded the Shoom club in a Southwark gym, a pivotal venue for the emergence of acid house in the UK. Rampling later became a high-profile radio host, presenting the 'Love Groove Dance Party' on BBC Radio 1 from 1994 to 2002. He was the first recipient of the 'World's No 1 DJ' award from DJ Magazine in 1991 and has also led the music project The Millionaire Hippies.
